- a brief description of the issue
- a photo of the item
- a photo of the care tag located inside the garment
If your request is approved, their team will email you a PREPAID LABEL.
Their policy also says that ONLY ITEMS RECEIVED DAMAGED OR INCORRECT ARE ELIGIBLE FOR AN EXCHANGE, and THE EXCHANGE CAN ONLY BE FOR THE SAME STYLE.
